steps.text: The "Allocation key generation" card is visible with the "Activated" badge. The deactivation button (×) is available at the top right of the card.
steps.title: Module active

steps.text: Click the × button at the top right of the card to deactivate the module. A confirmation will be required before removal.
steps.title: Deactivate the module

steps.text: A confirmation dialog appears. Click "Validate" to confirm deactivating the module and revoking member access.
steps.title: Confirm deactivation

steps.text: Confirm your choice in the confirmation dialog.
steps.title: Confirm

steps.text: The grid is empty again — the "Allocation key generation" module has been deactivated and is no longer accessible from the community.
steps.title: Module deactivated
